scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter '!next-app' --filter '!@workspace/mockup-sandbox' --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency 1 --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter '!@workspace/mockup-sandbox' --filter '!@workspace/next-app' --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.setup:env: echo "Create ignored .env.local or .env.production files from the documented variable list in SETUP.md."
